messages:
Priya: Heads up 7 marketplace invoice for PO 802234 got rejected. Partner invoiced hardware + support as a single line item and the marketplace requires separate SKU lines (HW sku vs services sku). Need quick fix 
AP-bot: Invoice 2024-899 rejected: LINE_ITEM_MISMATCH. Referenced SKU: RB-HW-XL not mapped to catalog entry for marketplace merchant-of-record. TAX_CODE mismatch for combined line. Status: HOLD. 
Megan: Marketplace EDI rules enforce product_code + tax_code per line. For deals with Redwood MO, partner must split physical goods (zero VAT in some EU flows) vs services (standard VAT). Can we take a manual exception for this one? 
Jorge: Partner (EdgePartners Ltd) says their ERP can't reissue before EOD Thursday due to month-end batching. They asked if Redwood can remap the SKU on our side to accept the invoice as-is. 
Sam: Finance: we can't map an unmapped SKU if the tax treatment differs. Risk of incorrect VAT reclaim. Two options: 1) partner reissues split invoice; 2) we accept invoice and raise P&L/tax reserve and treat as manual correction with procurement sign-off. 
Priya: We need to avoid credit hold for the partner. Sales prefers a quick mapping if legal signs off on limited acceptance. 
Legal: I can approve a short acceptance memo but need partner to sign that Redwood's acceptance of the combined invoice is an exception and they remain liable for accurate VAT charging. Drafting now. 
Finance-bot: TAX-LOCK flag: false. Alert: If we accept combined line we must record a tax reserve entry. Please attach proposed GL entry and assigned approvers. 
Megan: Quick technical note for AP: if we do manual mapping, set EDI field `line_item_override=true` and create a split accounting entry internally: 1) HW (SKU RB-HW-XL) -> GL 5400, VAT 0%; 2) Support (SKU RB-SERV-STD) -> GL 6200, VAT 20%. 
AP-bot: Created AP-TICKET-9012 for manual SKU mapping request. Status: waiting-on-legal-approval. 
Jorge: Partner can provide a signed letter accepting liability and a reissued split invoice early next week, but not before Friday. They asked whether Redwood can post payment to avoid cashflow issues. 
Priya: Quarter close on Friday 7 if payment is delayed we lose ARR recognition momentum. Sales will accept the liability memo and one-time payment as long as finance holds a tax reserve. 
Legal: Posting the memo here for sign: "Redwood will accept combined invoice #2024-899 as a one-time exception. Partner warrants VAT accuracy and indemnifies Redwood for any VAT shortfalls. This exception is not precedent." Keep partner signature + partner legal email. 
Megan: I'll run the reserve calc. AP: need approval chain: CFO -> Tax -> Legal. 
Finance-bot: Reserve calc needed: estimated VAT exposure = EUR 39,700. 
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-9012 status: pending-approvals. 
Priya: Action items: Jorge to get partner signature on memo by EOD tomorrow; Megan to compute reserve and post GL suggestion; Legal to circulate memo for signature; AP to prepare manual mapping process if approvals come through. Jira: SUPPORT-3499 (marketplace-sku-mapping). 
Jorge: Partner agreed to sign memo and advance payment if Redwood posts 50% as a prepayment to their account. They want confirmation today. 
Priya: Noted. Megan please confirm whether we can issue a 50% prepayment on exception. 
Megan: Prepayment needs treasury approval. I'll start that thread now and loop CFO. 
AP-bot: Escalation created: ESC-1120 treasury-prepay-request. 
Priya: Thanks all 7 I'll update the partner and post status here. If approvals don't land by COB escalate to CRO. :pray:
